verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's own workflows run unattended in the background. They are multi-action, attach to links (including automatically to every new link), and send timed reminders and messages. A 'Send a webhook' action fires at a set time before or after a meeting, and pending steps move when a meeting is rescheduled or are called off when it is cancelled. Webhooks retry automatically, and Zapier triggers extend this to other apps. Missing for 10: automations are limited to meeting-lifecycle triggers with no AI/agent-driven or general-purpose scheduled automation, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
